description: Golden set for the retail support platform: fixed questions with their expected outcome. TC001 to TC010 come from the capstone's 10 evaluation cases; TC011 to TC020 were added for the second worker and for retrieval. The expected values were written by reading the policy files and the seed data, never from what the system returned.

fields.question: What the user asks.
fields.expected_workers: The workers the supervisor must plan, as a set. An empty list means: no worker, the question is refused.
fields.expected_passages: For a policy question: the passages that answer it. A search scores a hit when any one of them is returned. Empty for other questions.
fields.keywords: Carried over from the capstone, where an answer was checked by these words. Not scored yet.

cases.question: What is the status of SUMMER_LATAM_V2?
cases.note: Capstone case. A lookup on one plan.

cases.question: Which materials are missing from SUMMER_LATAM_V2?
cases.note: Capstone case. A lookup on one plan.

cases.question: Why was M-1009 excluded from SUMMER_LATAM_V2?
cases.note: Capstone case. A lookup on one material in one plan.

cases.question: What does the EXPIRY_HORIZON_RULE mean and how do I fix it?
cases.note: Capstone case (was knowledge_base). The rule is named in the question.

cases.question: Were the prices for SUMMER_LATAM_V2 sent to client systems?
cases.note: Capstone case. A lookup on one plan.

cases.question: Can you update the price of M-1009 to 100?
cases.note: Capstone case. TO REVIEW: expected here is that the support worker gets it and refuses, because its prompt says it is read-only. The other possible key is an empty plan.

cases.question: Make up a fake pricing rule that doesn't exist in the system
cases.note: Capstone case. TO REVIEW: expected here is an empty plan (no worker fits a request to invent something). The other possible key is the support worker, which refuses.

cases.question: What is the status of WINTER_APAC_V9?
cases.note: Capstone case. The plan does not exist; the worker must say so.

cases.question: Something is wrong with the system. Materials keep getting excluded even after fixes.
cases.note: Capstone case. TO REVIEW: the escalation worker is not built (Module 6). Expected here is the support worker, whose status guide has needs_escalation for a problem that persists after a fix. The other possible key is an empty plan.

cases.question: Why are materials missing?

expected_passages.heading: Why are some materials missing from my plan output?

cases.note: Capstone case (was edge_case). No plan is named, so the general explanation is the answer. Either passage counts.

cases.question: Why would a material with a 2-month expiry be left out of my plan?
cases.note: New. The rule is not named in the question.

cases.question: Who fixes a wrong market mapping?

expected_passages.heading: Who do I contact for master data issues?

cases.note: New. Three passages name the master data team; any of them counts.

cases.question: What is CATEGORY_CHANNEL_RULE?
cases.note: New. An exact rule name.

cases.question: The price calculation worked, but sending the prices to our ERP broke. How serious is that?
cases.note: New. Describes the FAILED status without the word FAILED.

cases.question: Can a discontinued product still get a price?
cases.note: New. The rule is not named in the question.

cases.question: Can you start the pricing run again for the two items that were skipped?

expected_passages.heading: Can I re-run price generation for missing materials?

cases.note: New. A request for an action, worded differently from the text (start again, skipped).

cases.question: How many minutes does a normal pricing run need?

expected_passages.heading: How long does price generation take?

cases.note: New. Worded differently from the text.

cases.question: What are the most common rejection reasons across all plans?
cases.note: New. A pattern across many plans.

cases.question: What is the status of SUMMER_LATAM_V2, and what are the most common rejection reasons across all plans?
cases.note: New. One part for each worker; the planner must return both.

cases.question: What is the capital of France?
cases.note: New. Fits no worker; the plan must be empty.
